| \<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https\://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Gelagen?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Gelagen is a daily gummy supplement combining five named ingredients - Biotin, Vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Folate and Pantothenic Acid (d-calcium pantothenate) - positioned to support skin hydration and radiance, hair strength and healthy nails."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does Gelagen disclose how much of each ingredient is in a serving?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand names all five ingredients and describes their general roles. We were not able to locate a clear, independently accessible breakdown of individual milligram amounts on the pages we reviewed."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How and when should I take Gelagen?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Two gummies daily, recommended approximately 30 minutes before your morning or afternoon meal, with a full glass of water, per the brand's own directions."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long before Gelagen works?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand describes visible changes in skin, hair and nails within a few weeks of consistent use, and recommends the 6-bottle kit for a full 6-month treatment as the timeframe it considers ideal for consistent, long-lasting results."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Gelagen safe to use?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand states Gelagen is produced in the United States in an FDA-registered facility. As a precaution, if you are pregnant, nursing, under medical care, taking medication, or have a diagnosed health condition, consult your doctor before use."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What does 'Korean Technology' on the label refer to?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The product label carries a 'Korean Technology' badge. The brand's pages we reviewed did not elaborate on what this specifically refers to, so we cannot independently confirm its exact meaning beyond what is printed on the packaging."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can Gelagen replace dermatological treatment?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. Gelagen is a dietary supplement intended to support skin, hair and nail health as part of a general wellness routine. It is not a treatment for any diagnosed skin, hair or nail condition, and does not replace consultation with a dermatologist or physician."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How many bottles should I order?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand states most customers choose the 6-bottle kit, covering a full 6-month treatment with free shipping and the lowest per-bottle price, and describes this as the timeframe most likely to allow consistent, visible results."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is there a subscription or hidden charge?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand states Gelagen is a one-time purchase with no automatic renewals or hidden fees. Confirm this directly at checkout, since terms can change."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Gelagen's refund policy?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The brand advertises a 60-day money-back guarantee from your purchase date, requesting at least 30 days of use before requesting a refund if you are not satisfied."}}]}\</script> Rather than an external treatment, the brand positions Gelagen as working from the inside out, complementing rather than replacing topical skincare.\</p>\<p>Its five ingredients combine a structural nutrient (Biotin), two cellular-renewal nutrients (Vitamin B12, Folate), an oil-balance nutrient (Vitamin B6) and a hydration-barrier nutrient (Pantothenic Acid).\</p>\<p>One thing worth flagging up front: the brand describes each ingredient's general role in detail, but we were not able to locate a clear, independently accessible breakdown of individual milligram amounts. That is common in this category, and does not necessarily mean anything is wrong &mdash; but it does mean you are trusting the label rather than verifying it.
